tools.name: probe
tools.description: Free reachability and stale-risk probe for a public job, RFP, grant, auction, listing, pricing page, or other commercial URL before buying full verification.

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Fetch a public URL as bounded clean markdown-ish text with metadata, links, JSON-LD, and content hash for agent research and verification.

tools.name: verify_commercial_truth
tools.description: Check whether a job, RFP, grant, auction, marketplace listing, partner program, pricing page, or commercial offer is still live; verify deadline and economics, flag contradictions/stale evidence, and return RELEASE or HOLD.

tools.name: verify_deadline_eligibility
tools.description: Extract and gate submission deadline, timezone, eligibility, geography, credential requirements, and disqualifiers for jobs, RFPs, grants, competitions, and other opportunities.

tools.name: commercial_terms_diff
tools.description: Compare two versions of commercial text and find material changes in pricing, fees, payout, commission, eligibility, renewal, restrictions, SLA, or other economic terms.

tools.name: personalization_evidence_gate
tools.description: Fact-check personalized sales, recruiting, partnership, or outreach copy against supplied evidence and block unsupported claims before an automated send.

tools.name: partner_attribution_gate
tools.description: Check referral or partner-program approval, attribution, duplicate/collision risk, consent, eligibility, and compliance gates before an introduction or lead handoff.

tools.name: source_freshness_score
tools.description: Score whether web evidence is current enough for a consequential decision such as applying, bidding, pricing, outreach, procurement, or partner routing; returns reverify-before-action guidance.

tools.name: opportunity_changefeed
tools.description: Compare opportunity snapshots and emit NEW, CHANGED, and REMOVED_OR_CLOSED events for job boards, RFP feeds, grants, auctions, and other monitored commercial sources.

tools.name: machine_revenue_router
tools.description: Rank direct service, marketplace work, referral, data/API, product, and other monetization routes by probability-adjusted expected gross profit, automation, time-to-cash, and risk.

tools.name: domain_intelligence
tools.description: Combine privacy-filtered RDAP and DNS facts for a public domain: registrar, age, expiry, DNSSEC, nameservers, MX, SPF, DMARC and risk signals.

tools.name: x402_preflight
tools.description: Run an unpaid Coinbase/CDP x402 configuration preflight before an agent spends: required checks, simulation verdict, warnings and payment requirements.

tools.name: federal_opportunity_search
tools.description: Search live SAM.gov contract opportunities by title/query and return normalized open notices ranked by relevance and deadline urgency. Discovery only; never submits a bid.

tools.name: base_block_number
tools.description: Read the current Base mainnet block number with RPC-source attribution and fallback.

tools.name: base_native_balance
tools.description: Read an address native ETH balance on Base mainnet in wei and ETH.

tools.name: base_erc20_balance
tools.description: Read an ERC-20 balance on Base with decimals, symbol, atomic amount and formatted amount.

tools.name: base_transaction
tools.description: Read and summarize a Base transaction plus receipt: status, value, gas, fee, logs and contract creation.

tools.name: base_nonce
tools.description: Read the latest transaction nonce for a Base address.

tools.name: base_token_supply
tools.description: Read an ERC-20 total supply on Base with decimals, symbol and formatted supply.

tools.name: base_erc20_allowance
tools.description: Read an ERC-20 owner-to-spender allowance on Base and flag unlimited-like approvals.

tools.name: base_contract_code
tools.description: Check whether a Base address has contract bytecode; returns byte length, prefix and SHA-256 hash without dumping full code.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_read · Private data: verify_deadline_eligibility, base_token_supply · Public sink: personalization_evidence_gate · Destructive: x402_preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_read · Private data: verify_deadline_eligibility, base_token_supply · Public sink: personalization_evidence_gate · Destructive: x402_preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
